answer_1.quote: We present TIMEPLEX, a novel TKBC model, which obtains state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets for both link and time prediction.

answer_2.quote: Link prediction performance is evaluated by finding the rank of o ev in the list of all entities ordered by decreasing score φ assigned by the model, and computing MRR.

answer_3.quote: We compare against our reimplementations of CX, HyTE, TA-family, and TNT-Complex.

answer_4.quote: We report on experiments with four standard TKBC datasets.
